verdict.rationale: Founders claim benchmark-style accuracy figures (e.g. 87% on HotpotQA, ~90% on 'standard industry benchmarks') in HN comments, but these are informal forum claims, not a published benchmark report, and neither LongMemEval nor LoCoMo are mentioned anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: published benchmark report/paper, explicit LongMemEval/LoCoMo results, reproducible methodology or leaderboard.
